web.title: List of Los Angeles Metro Rail stations
web.description:
# List of Los Angeles Metro Rail stations The system includes 110 [metro stations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metro_station) on four [light rail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Light_rail) lines and two [rapid transit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rapid_transit) lines, covering 125.1 miles (201.3km) of route service. ## System The system has 110 stations serving its six lines. 14 stations are transfer stations, which allow passengers to transfer between lines. 11 stations are [termini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Train_station#Terminus)—stations at the end of lines. 57 of the stations are within the city of Los Angeles, and the other 53 stations are located in surrounding communities in Los Angeles County. ### Lines | Name | Stations | Termini | Opening | Newest extension | Length[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Los_Angeles_Metro_Rail_stations#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Los_Angeles_Metro_Rail_stations#cite_note-25)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Los_Angeles_Metro_Rail_stations#cite_note-FactsGlance-1) | Ridership

web.description:
# Metro Facts at a Glance
## ![Metro image 1](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/icon-rail.svg) Metro Rail
- Stations: **115** _(Updated May 11, 2026, after the opening of D Line Extension 1)_

### Metro A Line ![Metro image 2](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/icon-A-line.svg)
- Stations: **48** (5 shared with E Line)

### Metro B Line ![Metro image 3](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/icon-B-line.svg)
- Stations: **14** (6 shared with D Line)

### Metro C Line ![Metro image 4](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/icon-C-line.svg)
- Stations: **12** (2 shared with K line)

### Metro D Line ![Metro image 5](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/icon-D-line.svg)
- Stations: **11** (6 shared with B Line)

## ![Metro image 8](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/icon-bus-NEW.svg)Metro Busways
### Metro G Line ![Metro image 9](https://www.metro.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/icon-G-line.svg)
- Stations: **17**(16 are operational; Van Nuys Boulevard Station currently closed through 2027)

# The Ultimate Guide to the Los Angeles Metro System
## A little Background
The Los Angeles Metro Rail systems has been around since 1990 and serves 93 stations throughout the metro area.

## Visiting Popular Attractions in Los Angeles with the Metro
- 7th/Metro Center Station: LA Live, and the Fig at 7th shopping center. Here you can connect to the Expo line and ride it to Santa Monica.
